subtitleEn: The sounds of Quenya. Pronunciation and accentuation.
goalZh: 掌握元音、辅音、重音规则，能按附录 E 朗读昆雅文本。

subtitleEn: Nouns. Plural form. The article.
goalZh: 理解名词复数 -i/-r、定冠词 i 及无冠词语义。

subtitleEn: Dual number. Stem variation.
goalZh: 区分自然双数与 attá + 复数；掌握 -u/-t 双数词尾。

subtitleEn: The Adjective. The Copula. Adjectival agreement in number.
goalZh: 形容词一致、系词 ná/nar、定语与表语位置。

subtitleEn: The Verb: Present tense and agreement in number. Subject/object. The superlative form of adjectives.
goalZh: 现在时 -ë/-i 及与主语数一致；最高级 an-。

subtitleEn: Past tense
goalZh: Elen síla 式过去时；译语到昆雅的变换。

subtitleEn: Future tense and Aorist
goalZh: 将来时 -uva；Híril 不可分 aorist。

subtitleEn: Perfect tense. Pronominal endings -n(yë), -l(yë), -s.
goalZh: 前缀 ai-/au- 与脱元音；人称尾 -nye/-lye/-nye 等。

subtitleEn: The infinitive. The negative verb. Active participles.
titleZh: 不定式、否定动词与主动分词
goalZh: 动词不定式、ú- 否定；主动分词 -la/-da。

subtitleEn: Adverbs. The pronominal endings -ntë and -t. Infinitives with object pronouns. The past tense of intransitive verbs in -ya. Passive participles.
titleZh: 副词、人称尾与被动分词
goalZh: -ntë/-t；副词构成；-ya 不及物过去时。

subtitleEn: The concept of cases. The Genitive case.
goalZh: 步行格体系；属格 -o / -ion。

subtitleEn: The Possessive-Adjectival case. Verbal or Abstract nouns and how they interact with the Genitive and Possessive cases.
goalZh: -va 领属与抽象名词；与属格互动。

subtitleEn: The Dative case. The Gerund. The pronominal endings -lmë, -lvë and -mmë. An indefinite pronoun.
goalZh: 与格 -n/-en；-lmë/-lvë/-mmë；不定代词。

subtitleEn: The Allative and Ablative cases. Equë and auta: two peculiar verbs. Possessive pronominal endings: -nya, -lya, -lva, -lma, -mma
goalZh: -nna/-llo；equë、auta；领属代词尾。

subtitleEn: The ending -rya and more about possessive pronominal endings. The Locative case. Relative sentences. Third Person obscurities.
goalZh: -rya 领属；方位 -ssë；关系从句。

subtitleEn: The Instrumental case. Verbs with an unaccented vowel + -ta. The imperative. The nai formula.
goalZh: -nen 工具格；á 祈使；nai 句式。

subtitleEn: The demonstratives: Sina, tan(y)a, enta, yana. Inflecting the "Last Declinable Word". U-stem nouns. Ordinals in -ëa.
titleZh: 指示词、末位变格与 U 词干
goalZh: sina/tanya/enta/yana；末词曲折；U 词干名。

subtitleEn: Independent pronouns. Impersonal verbs. U-stem verbs. The various uses of lá.
titleZh: 独立代词、无人称动词与 lá
goalZh: 强调/独立人称；无人称；lá 多种含义。

subtitleEn: Pronouns in imperative phrases. Emphatic pronouns. Question-words: Man, mana, manen. Postpositions.
titleZh: 命令句代词、强调代词、疑问词与后置词
goalZh: man/mana/manen；强调代词；祈使短语。

subtitleEn: The obscure verb "to be". Ma as a possible interrogative particle. Sa introducing nominal clauses.
titleZh: to be 的诸形式、ma 与 sa 从句
goalZh: ná/nat 系词；ma 疑问；sa 从句。
